newsitem.title: UK: Two Osebergs cancelled from July programme - trade.
newsitem.headline: Two Osebergs cancelled from July programme - trade.

text.p: Two cargoes from Norway's Oseberg system equivalent to about 1.1 million barrels have been cancelled from the July programme, a North Sea crude trader said on Wednesday.
"They've been cancelled just because of lower production," a trader for one of the equity holders said without elaborating.
One cargo was loading July 4-6 and one was July 3-5. One was a standard cargo of 500,000 barrels and the other was 600,000 barrels.

Norway's Oseberg crude system was due to load the equivalent of 40.8 standard cargoes of 500,000 barrels in July. The programme consisted of 24 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, six of 500,000 barrels and one each of two million and one million barrels.
The Oseberg system was due to load the equivalent of 30.7 standard cargoes in June.
